meaning_en: complete, total, or without doubt
example_en: It's an absolute pleasure to meet you.
examples_extra: The party was an absolute disaster.
She has absolute trust in her doctor.
note_fa: «یعنی «کامل، مطلق»؛ با اسم‌های منفی هم می‌آید: absolute chaos.»

meaning_en: Another choice or option.
example_en: Is there an alternative route to avoid traffic?
examples_extra: Is there an alternative to taking the car?
We had no alternative but to wait.
note_fa: عبارت: have no alternative but to.

meaning_en: The state of being completely sure about something.
example_en: There is no certainty about the future.
examples_extra: Nobody can predict the future with certainty.
She spoke with absolute certainty.

meaning_en: The possibility of something happening.
example_en: There's a good chance it will rain later.
examples_extra: There's a good chance it will rain tomorrow.
She has little chance of winning the race.

meaning_en: The act of choosing between things.
example_en: You have a choice of three colours.
examples_extra: You made a good choice with that car.
We have no choice but to leave now.
note_fa: ترکیب مهم: make a choice یعنی تصمیم گرفتن.

meaning_en: Required by a rule or law; mandatory.
example_en: School attendance is compulsory for children.
examples_extra: English is a compulsory subject in our school.
Wearing seat belts is compulsory in this country.

meaning_en: To manage without something you usually have.
example_en: We can do without a car for a week.
examples_extra: I cannot do without my morning coffee.
We had to do without heating for two days.
note_fa: یعنی بدون چیزی سر کردن؛ بعدش اسم می‌آید: do without sugar.

meaning_en: Unlikely to happen or be true.
example_en: It's doubtful that the weather will improve.
examples_extra: It is doubtful whether he will pass the exam.
She gave me a doubtful look.

meaning_en: Not required to do something others must do.
example_en: Students are exempt from paying the fee.
examples_extra: Students are exempt from paying the entrance fee.
Small businesses are exempt from this new tax.
note_fa: معاف؛ exempt from یعنی معاف از.

meaning_en: make someone do something they don't want.
example_en: They tried to force him into signing the contract.
examples_extra: They tried to force him into signing the contract.
Don't force her into a decision she doesn't want.
note_fa: مجبور کردن به کاری: force sb into doing sth.

meaning_en: Certain to happen and impossible to avoid.
example_en: Change is an inevitable part of life.
examples_extra: Change is inevitable in every large organisation.
It was inevitable that they would meet again.

meaning_en: To not have enough of something.
example_en: The project failed due to a lack of funding.
examples_extra: They lack clean drinking water.
He lacks confidence in himself.

meaning_en: Responsible by law for something.
example_en: The company is liable for any damage.
examples_extra: The company was held liable for the damage.
You are liable if your dog bites someone.

meaning_en: Required by law or rules; compulsory.
example_en: Wearing a helmet is mandatory for cyclists.
examples_extra: Wearing a helmet is mandatory.
English is mandatory in this school.

meaning_en: Something that is needed or required.
example_en: Food and water are basic necessities.
examples_extra: Clean drinking water is a basic human necessity.
Reliable cars are a real necessity out here now.

meaning_en: A requirement or strong desire for something.
example_en: There is a great need for more doctors.
examples_extra: There is a growing need for more nurses.
The desperate need for speed always thrilled him.

meaning_en: Something you must do; a duty.
example_en: It's my obligation to help them.
examples_extra: Parents have an obligation to care for their children.
I feel an obligation to help my old neighbours.
note_fa: تعهد/وظیفه؛ have an obligation to یعنی «موظف بودن».

meaning_en: Required by law or rule; compulsory.
example_en: Wearing a helmet is obligatory.
examples_extra: English is obligatory in all secondary schools here.
Wearing a helmet is obligatory for cyclists.

meaning_en: To force someone to do something.
example_en: The law will oblige them to pay.
examples_extra: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
I felt obliged to accept their kind invitation.
note_fa: مجبور کردن؛ feel obliged یعنی «احساس تکلیف کردن».

meaning_en: You can choose to do it or not.
example_en: The extra course is optional, not compulsory.
examples_extra: English is optional this year.
The trip is optional, not required.

meaning_en: Something that might happen or be true.
example_en: There's a possibility of rain today.
examples_extra: There is a possibility of rain.
We discussed every possibility carefully.

meaning_en: Likely to happen or be true.
example_en: It is probable that it will rain.
examples_extra: The probable cause was a fire.
It is probable that it will rain.

meaning_en: Something you need or must do.
example_en: Meeting all the project requirements is essential for success.
examples_extra: A degree is a requirement for this job.
The hotel met all safety requirements for guests.
note_fa: a requirement for: شرط لازم برای چیزی.

meaning_en: A situation where there is not enough of something.
example_en: There is a shortage of water in the city.
examples_extra: There is a severe water shortage in the region.
The growing shortage of nurses worries us all.

meaning_en: To agree to a demand or request.
example_en: The government finally acceded to the public's demands.
examples_extra: He acceded to their demands.
She finally acceded to the request.

meaning_en: To accept something reluctantly without protest.
example_en: She acquiesced to her parents' wishes.
examples_extra: He acquiesced to the committee's decision.
She would not acquiesce silently.

meaning_en: Official agreement or approval.
example_en: The committee gave its assent to the new proposal.
examples_extra: She nodded slowly in assent.
The committee gave its assent.

meaning_en: To give official permission for something.
example_en: The manager authorised the purchase of new equipment.
examples_extra: Only managers can authorise payments.
The sale was authorised by the board.

meaning_en: Complete freedom to act as one wishes.
example_en: The designer was given carte blanche for the new project.
examples_extra: They gave her carte blanche.
He has carte blanche on the design.
note_fa: اختیار تام؛ از فرانسوی؛ تلفظ /ˌkɑːt ˈblɑːnʃ/.

meaning_en: To take strong action to stop something illegal or unwanted.
example_en: Authorities decided to clamp down on illegal street racing.
examples_extra: The government clamped down on illegal street racing.
Police are clamping down on drunk driving this month.

meaning_en: To accept or allow behavior that is morally wrong.
example_en: The school does not condone any form of bullying.
examples_extra: No decent society can condone such violent behaviour.
His long silence seemed to condone the cheating.

meaning_en: To admit as acceptable or possible.
example_en: The school will not countenance cheating in exams.
examples_extra: No government would countenance abolishing taxes.
She would not countenance such rude behaviour.
note_fa: رسمی و معمولاً منفی: تحمل یا اجازه دادن.

meaning_en: To publicly support or approve of something.
example_en: The celebrity agreed to endorse the new product.
examples_extra: The committee endorsed the new policy.
She refused to endorse the product.
note_fa: تایید کردن؛ حمایت علنی از چیزی.

meaning_en: Give someone complete freedom to act as they wish.
example_en: The director gave the artist carte blanche for the new design.
examples_extra: He gave her carte blanche on the design.
The boss gave me carte blanche.

meaning_en: Give permission for something to happen.
meaning_fa: اجازه دادن، چراغ سبز نشان دادن
example_en: The council gave the go-ahead for the new building project.
examples_extra: They gave the go-ahead for the project.
The council gave the go-ahead for building.

meaning_en: Give permission for something to proceed.
example_en: The board gave the green light to the merger.
examples_extra: They gave the green light to the plan.
The minister gave the green light to the deal.

meaning_en: To make something illegal or forbidden.
example_en: The government plans to outlaw smoking in public parks.
examples_extra: They outlawed smoking indoors everywhere.
Parliament outlawed the cruel practice.

meaning_en: Without paying attention to the present circumstances.
meaning_fa: صرف نظر از، بدون توجه به
example_en: We will proceed with the plan, regardless of the weather.
examples_extra: She went, regardless of the rain.
He continues working regardless now.
note_fa: کتاب: regardless is an adverb؛ یعنی «صرف‌نظر از»؛ regardless of.

meaning_en: To reject a decision or proposal.
example_en: The President can veto any bill passed by Congress.
examples_extra: The president vetoed the bill.
They vetoed the proposal yesterday.
